title: Keep resource tier classification invariant under checkout relocation
summary: Outer scratch or knowledge partitions describe checkout placement, not the data tier of inner repository resources.
hint_triggers: Before interpreting tier markers, use the canonical policy-relative path mapping for current-checkout and shared primary-authority resources. Preserve normalized absolute fallback for genuinely outside-root paths; do not repair ancestor shadowing by reordering substring tests. Declare expected inner partitions independently of the production parser, enumerate relocation across tiered scratch/artifact/runtime/knowledge ancestors, compare production results, and require an ancestor-first negative control. Build before compiled-module integration tests. The finite path model complements tenant, resource and symlink guards; it does not replace them.
